profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer & Architect | DeFi Protocol Design, Security, Research & Data
profile.summary: I design and build DeFi systems, from smart contracts and automation to data infrastructure and analytics. My work also spans EVM and security research, smart contract audits, and protocol risk analysis, helping teams understand how systems behave, where they can fail, and how to improve them.

positions.title: Software Engineer & Technical Advisor
positions.description: Independent engineering, research, and advisory services for DeFi teams.

positions.title: System Integrator
positions.description:
- Design, development, and integration of a globally-scaled data authorization system which governs access to export control, IP, and privacy data
- Highly performant distributed systems architecture
- Application continuous integration and containerized deployment via OpenShift
- Manage API lifecycle and security

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
-Develop software applications and tools for internal Boeing customers
-Agile development project management and technical lead
-Built and maintain multiple 100+ user web applications
-IBM Business Process Manager (BPM) developer
-Proficient in JavaScript, PHP as well as MVC frameworks including AngularJS  and CodeIgniter
-SQL Server, MySQL development

positions.title: Network Designer
positions.description: Network management and monitoring. Software and tools development.

positions.title: Versatile Technologist
positions.description: IT Project management for data center modernization and application and server migration.

positions.title: President
positions.description:
•Manage relationships with outside companies to organize recruiting and informational events.
•Responsible for all club event scheduling and promotion efforts.
•Help lead and organize board and memeber meetings.
•Liaison between club and MIS faculty as well as the Federation of Eller Student Organizations.

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description:
Involved in the planning and deployment of new back-end IT systems and smartphone solutions
Managed and participated in several wide-scale device piloting trials 
Performed ROI and business analysis on potential IT infrastructure solutions

positions.title: MIS Intern
positions.description:
•Experience with phone and computer networking.
•Experience working with Windows Server, Active Directory, VPN gateways, LAN/WAN technologies, and AS/400 database.
•Experience working with PHP intranet development in a professional environment.
•Responsible for delivering help desk support to approx 150 internal clients.

positions.title: Assistant Corporate Director
positions.description:
•Involved in planning and coordinating a 30,000 person community event carried out entirely by a small team of university students.
•Led efforts to get sponsorship contracts signed by local and national companies.
•Coordinated sponsorship recruitment efforts and worked with companies to achieve their advertising strategies.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Computer and Information Systems Security/Information Assurance
